item.title: American Airlines briefly grounded in U.S. by IT issue
item.description: A nationwide ground stop briefly prevented American Airlines flights from taking off on Tuesday due to a technology issue.

item.title: Stung by Apple's recent iPad price hike? This budget Samsung tablet costs less than half the price of the entry-level iPad
item.description: There's no need to spend hundreds of dollars on a good tablet — Samsung's A series Tabs offer excellent bang for buck and the latest Galaxy Tab A11+ is now 35% off on Amazon for the 256GB flavour.
